name: zdeclient_copy_feature_entries_forward
description: zDEClient::CopyFeatureEntriesForward copies feature-entry records forward from a source range into a destination range.
known_limits: The original helper is VC-era vector support code using raw 13-dword record copies and thiscall/stdcall-like cleanup shape. tier S is deferred to the zDEClient vector/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x458a30 validates copying 13 dwords per zDEClient_FeatureEntry from first to dest while first != last, skipping the store when dest is null, advancing both pointers by 52 bytes, and returning the advanced destination pointer.
The native helper smoke verifies forward copying of crater and quicksand records and the returned advanced destination pointer.
